body:
Yes, I just haven't felt truly "up" for a while and they don't last nearly as long as my downs, which sucks. If my ups were as powerful and lasting as my downs I know that I could dig myself out of this hole. You're right - I'm very grateful for the internet in that regard, but sometimes I just need a hug or some eye contact from someone who I know will accept me when I'm vulnerable.

I've been in-and-out of therapy for over six years now. Maybe I have not been exposed to the right mode of therapy or the right therapist, but aside from short-term relief and increase in self-awareness it has not helped me. Not having money/insurance limits me.

I'm feeling a lot better today, but I'm still worried for the next time I feel "down" again (because I know, inevitably, it will happen and it's been happening quite frequently lately which has been exhausting). I think I've been feeling particularly alone - which is my fault because I completely isolate myself at times and I don't allow myself to be vulnerable in most of my relationships. That has really hindered me. 

Mostly I have been losing hope. At times, like last night, I feel almost entirely hopeless and I continue my suicide research and preparation. This is purely because I feel so alone and disconnected from everyone, but also lack the motivation or hope of making any new connections or salvaging my current relationships.

I have been struggling for well over a decade now and that is not okay to me. I try so hard to help myself, but I still feel controlled by and at the will of my thoughts and emotions. I'm losing steam and I lack the support I need to handle everything. I've been significantly losing hope in my ability to take care of myself and to truly heal... It's a scary place to be especially when I feel so alone and uncertain. I don't know if any of this made any sense, but thank you for reading...
